{{Quote|What is that strange clothing?''"<br />"''It's the traditional rebreather garb of Iskalonian travellers.|[[Plif/Legends|Plif]] and Kiro|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 82">[[Star Wars (1977) 82|''Star Wars'' (1977) 82]]</ref>}}
The '''Iskalonian rebreather garb''' was a type of traditional [[Rebreather/Legends|rebreather]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was worn by the few [[Iskalonian]]s who wished to travel offworld. It was made of high-impact [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]] and kept [[Water/Legends|water]] circulating inside the armor, since the Iskalonians could only breathe by extracting dissolved [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] from water. Although those garbs were already ancient at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], some were still serviceable. When [[Kiro]] decided to accompany [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in his adventures, he donned one such traditional suit, which was later destroyed during a confrontation with [[Lumiya]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]].
